method: Two anonymous PostgREST GETs on the same intentionally nonexistent relation, with active Supabase publishable key, one Accept-Profile: public, one Accept-Profile: private
note: PGRST106 is PostgREST schema-not-exposed; PGRST205 on public proves the request reached PostgREST. Runtime configuration can change; run the canonical probe before release. This check is independent of RLS and of real authenticated cross-account isolation.
